PRINCIPLE: A management dashboard shows why workers are busy, not what individual actions they're taking. 'Browser: screenshot' is observing keystrokes. 'Pixel Office → Management Tool Upgrade' is useless — user already knows that.

SOURCE: User explicitly rejected tool-call-based summaries multiple times. The key quote: 'I need to focus on what is happening right fucking now.'

APPLICATION:
- The user's latest prompt IS the current focus
- Panel should lead with current action/focus, not project name
- Information hierarchy: (1) current focus/intent, (2) worker identity + project, (3) recent tools only in expanded view
- Don't show information the user already knows (project name, their own task title)
- 'Working on WorkerPanel.tsx' > 'Browser: screenshot' > 'Editing file'
- LLM title generation: last 4 user turns + current task → 3-8 word active title
